label: Tag run
description: Tag this run so a later run can stop it with StopTagged (e.g. a new message stops the reply still in flight). Each wired input is a tag, plus the `tags` list. Any string works: unsafe characters are replaced and a fingerprint added, so two different values never share a tag.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags as one list; added to the wired inputs.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the tags are on; gate StopTagged on it.

then.message: TagRun '{id}' has no tag to put on the run. Add an input onto the node (`TagRun(sender: String)`), or give it a `tags` list.
